phase_name: Final gate run, baseline diff, and reproducibility record

objectives.description: Re-run all Phase 1 gate commands post-sweep, diff against pre-sweep baseline, confirm check-task-references/run-all/detector, write summary with dispositions table and deferred items
objectives.note: Discovered a self-inflicted concurrent-write interleaving defect in both baseline captures (verify-deploy.sh's background output racing with foreground appends to the same file). No content was lost; corrected both files by reassembling scattered fragments into one contiguous, correctly-ordered verify-deploy.sh section. Traced all 7 new post-sweep gate findings to expected, self-resolving pre-redeploy source-vs-deployed drift caused by this sweep's own legitimate edits, plus one recurrence of the already-documented gate8 concurrency flake -- none are unexplained regressions.

approaches_tried.approach: Running verify-deploy.sh in the background while sequentially appending other command outputs to the same target file
approaches_tried.reason: Caused byte-level interleaving corruption of the baseline capture files -- verify-deploy.sh's slow nested run-all.sh made its background write span long enough to race with several foreground appends to the same file
